question: What is the passage about?

options.text: Metro life and the subway facilities
The risky life in the subways

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the various factors that lead to air pollution within subways.
 
• It comments on the different contributing elements, such as station design characteristics, train components, and ventilation systems that exacerbate air pollution.
 
• It highlights the risk factors connected to subway air pollution, mentioning the dominant iron particles in the air and potential cardiovascular disease risk for subway employees, specifically those working on the platforms.
 
• Therefore, 'Option 3' (The risky life in the subways) best encompasses the main topic of the passage as it discusses the health risk and pollution problems associated with subway life.

Therefore, the correct answer is - **'Option 3'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• 'Option 1' (Metro life and the subway facilities) and 'Option 4' (Pollution created by the railroad) focus only partially on the topics mentioned in the passage, omitting the critical health risks discussed.
 
• 'Option 2' (The benefits of subway life) is not reflected in the passage at all, as no beneficial aspects of subway life are mentioned.
 
• So, these options do not accurately describe the totality of the passage's content.
